description: This file defines a set of type validation functions under the object 't', including functions for string, number, boolean, null, undefined, enum, nullable, optional, array, and recursive schemes. It also includes a checkScheme function for validating objects against schemes, and utility functions for error reporting.

methods.name: checkScheme
methods.description: Validates an object against a given scheme, throwing an error if the scheme is undefined or if validation fails.
